vision_question: Can SOFCs deliver grid-parity LCOE by 2035?

feasibility.rationale: AI data center power demand creates a real customer pull, but stack durability + system cost are still gating mass adoption.

capabilities.name: Stack durability + degradation
capabilities.description: Cell + stack operating life under continuous duty; degradation rate target < 0.2%/1000hr.
capabilities.rationale: Stack replacement frequency drives LCOE; binding constraint on grid-parity timeline.

score.rationale: Bloom Energy: 4-year stack life proven; degradation 0.3%/1000hr — not yet sufficient.

capabilities.name: System cost ($/kW) trajectory
capabilities.description: Installed system cost decline driven by manufacturing scale + BoP simplification.
capabilities.rationale: Each 50% cost-down doubles the addressable customer base; learning rate ~12-15% per doubling.

score.rationale: Current $6.5k/kW; need $3.5k/kW for grid parity at typical NG prices.

capabilities.name: AI data center primary/backup power demand
capabilities.description: Hyperscaler RFPs for distributed SOFC primary or backup power at MW class.
capabilities.rationale: Demand-pull from AI DCs could leapfrog SOFC past traditional utility-scale adoption gates.

score.rationale: Multiple hyperscaler announcements; Bloom Energy / Microsoft pilot at 100MW class.

capabilities.name: Fuel economics (NG → H2 transition)
capabilities.description: Fuel input cost track: natural gas baseline → green hydrogen target.
capabilities.rationale: Carbon-credit eligibility depends on H2 transition; without it SOFCs remain a parity-gas play.

score.rationale: Green H2 still 3-4× higher than NG on energy basis; trending down but slow.

capabilities.name: Manufacturing capacity ramp
capabilities.description: Annual gigawatt-class stack manufacturing capacity online and in pipeline.
capabilities.rationale: Without manufacturing scale, learning-rate-based cost-down doesn't materialize.

score.rationale: Bloom + Ceres expanding; aggregate industry ramp ~0.5 GW/y today, need ~5 GW/y by 2030.

capabilities.name: Utility permitting + grid interconnection
capabilities.description: Utility permit + grid interconnection timelines for distributed SOFC at scale.
capabilities.rationale: Permit timeline is a known DCMA bottleneck; can add 18-36 months to project economics.

score.rationale: FERC + state PUC reform progressing slowly; California pilot programs underway.

dependencies.rationale: Longer stack life amortizes replacement capex.
Fuel cost is the second-biggest LCOE input.

risks.name: Green hydrogen infrastructure delay
risks.description: Green H2 production + distribution scale-up is sub-linear vs forecasts; could miss the 2030 cost target.
risks.mitigations: Maintain NG-compatible architecture; lobby for hydrogen tax credits.

risks.name: Natural gas carbon pricing uncertainty
risks.description: EU CBAM + US state-level carbon pricing volatility makes NG-fed SOFC economics unpredictable.
risks.mitigations: Lock in carbon-cost passthrough clauses with utility customers.

risks.name: Cathode/anode rare-earth supply
risks.description: Yttria-stabilized zirconia + LSM cathode rare-earth supply chain concentrated in China.
risks.mitigations: Qualify non-China suppliers; substitute with cobalt-based formulations.
